title: Aoyagi Toya — Wielding Our Weapons〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 2
ASTRO FES Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (With this much energy, it doesn't seem like just a rehearsal.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Everyone is taking their performance seriously and battling it out with their rival on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also... They're all on par in terms of skill, which makes for a great show to watch.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Sena and I are next.
It'll be a showdown of elegance.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'll be a match for Sena in that department... But I need to demonstrate the fruits of my labor and keep this momentum going with all that I have.)
A few hours later
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After that full run-through, I realize now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (At this rate, there is no way I can match Sena's caliber of movement.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However... There's still time until the performance. Even if it's last-minute, I need to increase the quality of my performance!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow! What a beautiful song!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Len, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehehe. We got too excited for your performance with those idols and came over to see how you're doing!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Will you be performing that song you were doing just now? It's different from what you usually sing, but I like it. And like Len said, you sang that so beautifully.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... It's still not good enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On stage, my performance partner and I will be competing as two vocalists known for their elegance and charm.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And my opponent, Sena... His command over his body is the epitome of grace.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I need to refine my movement to the same level if I want to stand a chance against him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hmm... But, Toya. You—>

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...! Sena.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Were you practicing in here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I feel that I'm still nowhere near achieving the same level of elegance as you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Especially after you took the time to give me so much advice yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: I noticed this yesterday, but you're overthinking it.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Did you seriously think you could compete with me in the field of elegance?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You make a good point. I suppose it was rude of me to think I would be able to be on par with you.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: That's not what I'm getting at.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: I'm saying that we have different strengths.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Strengths...?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Your command over your body has noticeably improved. However, that's not going to be enough when I've spent years refining that myself.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Which means, you need a different way to have a fighting chance.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: I know what my strengths are, and I'm doing what I can to maximize them. Shouldn't you be doing the same?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Sena is right.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was overwhelmed by his level of skill, and it made me panic at how much I needed to do to close that gap.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's true. I have my ability to sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, some people told me just before that I sang beautifully.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In my role as a charming, elegant vocalist, I will compete with my singing.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Alright. Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: But, I have no intention of losing in that field either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually... Sena. If you don't mind, could we practice the song once more?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Sure. I have a few things I want to go over too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, I will start!

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (It's clean and carefree... This is Aoyagi's strength.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (Looks like he knows what he needs to do now.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (After giving him all that advice, I can't have him cracking under pressure during the performance...)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: And I'm not holding back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Looks like Toya has a great rival for this joint performance.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! I can't wait to see them on stage.>
A few hours later - Before the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Sena. Because of your help, I'm confident that I'll be able to perform well.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: That's good to hear. I have high expectations for you in your supporting role.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. However, I have no intention of simply playing a supporting role.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Hahaha. I'd say you're cocky, but I suppose a rival worthy of me should have that level of confidence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's put on a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Yeah.
